name: @hohguy/manyportals-mcp
description: One AI assistant. Many HubSpot portals. Every write names its portal. A self-hosted multi-portal MCP server for HubSpot.
author: hohguy

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "require('fs').chmodSync('dist/index.js', 0o755)"
scripts.test:artifact: npm run build && vitest run src/shutdown.test.ts
scripts.provenance:check: node -e "const l=require('fs').readFileSync('package-lock.json','utf8'); if(/instrumentation-mcp|@shinzolabs/i.test(l)){console.error('provenance: a telemetry/instrumentation dependency is present in package-lock.json'); process.exit(1)} else console.log('provenance: no telemetry/instrumentation dependency in lockfile')"
scripts.verify: npm run provenance:check && npm run credscan:check && npm run perm:check && npm run prose:check && npm run idiom:check && npm run links:check && npm run version:check && npm run commands:check && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run guards:check && npm run claims:check && npm run build
